description: This file defines the BackendChain class, which implements a chained cache backend for Drupal. It manages multiple cache backends, allowing them to be combined so that cache operations are propagated across all backends, enabling layered caching strategies.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Cache\BackendChain
classes.description: Implements a chain of cache backends, allowing multiple cache storage mechanisms to be used together in Drupal.

methods.name: appendBackend
methods.description: Adds a cache backend to the end of the chain.

methods.name: prependBackend
methods.description: Adds a cache backend to the beginning of the chain.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by ID, checking backends in order and propagating the result to earlier backends if found.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items by their IDs, propagating retrieved items to earlier backends.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cache item across all backends.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Sets multiple cache items across all backends.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by ID from all backends.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items from all backends.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all cache items from all backends.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by ID across all backends.

methods.name: invalidateMultiple
methods.description: Invalidates multiple cache items across all backends.

methods.name: invalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates cache items by tags, if backends support tag invalidation.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Deprecated method to invalidate all cache, triggers a deprecation warning, and calls invalidateAll on each backend.

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Performs garbage collection on all backends.

methods.name: removeBin
methods.description: Removes the backend's binary data from all backends.
